answers.core:
It's a limitation with the line 2d nodes and an add-on to fix this don't make sense.
There are more applications for this feature like scrolling animated beams, electricity, water or as my case making sure a closing line 2d is seamless.
answers.workaround: No, because I can't find a way to override the line 2d renderer and override the whole drawing for this feature should be overkill.
